name: Mental Disorders: Followers of Tzeentch
description: Black Crusade, Table 8-5 (p. 278). Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Obsessive Cleanliness
results.text: Confronted with filth or disease, the character must pass a Difficult (-10) Willpower Test or refuse to enter the area or interact with the unclean object or person.

results.name: Conspiracy Theorist
results.text: -5 to all Interaction Tests, except with those who share his theories.

results.name: Rule of Nine
results.text: No mechanical penalty. The character is compelled to arrange things in nines and treats the number as portentous.

results.name: Dark Magiks
results.text: -5 to Interaction Tests with ordinary people, and -10 when dealing with actual psykers.
